summary: Build practical BESS skills in sizing, integration, safety, commissioning, and reporting. Join TrainingCred’s 5-day course and apply them on the job.
lede: Battery storage training covers engineering decisions for sizing, integrating, commissioning, and operating energy storage systems. It is designed for professionals working with electrical systems, renewable projects, or energy assets who need practical skills to assess loads and support project delivery. Participants compare battery chemistries, develop one-line integration diagrams, prepare commissioning plans, and consider monitoring, operational risks, degradation, and lifecycle costs.
audienceIntro: This course is intended for professionals who already work with electrical systems, renewable projects, or energy assets and need practical battery energy storage systems capability.
audience: Battery Energy Storage Systems O&M Supervisors
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, a spreadsheet tool, and familiarity with electrical engineering terminology. A background in renewable energy, grid integration, or power systems will help you move faster through the applied exercises.
